app.title: Muse Spark Open
app.author: bigwheels
app.description: A newly released open‑source multimodal large language model from Meta, trained on image and text data, available for download and local inference.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run pip install -e .
Download the pretrained weights and load the model via the provided Python API.
Run a text prompt and verify that output is a non‑empty string.
Generate an image from a prompt and check that the image file is created and has non‑zero dimensions.
Measure inference latency for a 512 token text prompt and compare against a baseline LLaMA model.
